competences.description: Attacks the enemy to decrease its Attack Power for 2 turns with a 50% chance.

effets.description: The target's Attack Power will be decreased by 50%.

competences.description: Attacks all enemies 2 times. Each hit decreases their Attack Bar by 15% with an 80% chance and decreases their Defense for 2 turns with a 30% chance.

effets.description: The target's Defense will be decreased by 70%.

competences.description: Attacks all enemies to stun for 1 turn and absorb their Attack Bar. The damage is proportionate to your MAX HP. The fewer enemies there are, the greater the damage dealt and the amount of Attack Bar absorbed. In addition, increases your MAX HP by 20%, up to 100%, each time this skill is used.

effets.description: The target will be stunned and won't be able to attack.
Steal ATB from the enemy and add it to yourself
effets.note: The fewer enemies there are, the greater the amount of Attack Bar Absorbed

effets.description: MAX HP increases by given amount under certain conditions
effets.note: Up to 100%, each time this skill is used
